source_paper.title: A brain-wide map of neural activity during complex behaviour

evidence.locator: Methods: Neural analyses; Inclusion criteria; Overview of decoding; Decoding target variables; Decoding cross-validation; Decoding significance testing with null distributions
evidence.supports: Original regional decoding uses balanced accuracy for stimulus/choice/feedback and R-squared for wheel variables, with repeated nested within-session cross-validation and null-corrected regional effects.
The 2023_12_bwm_release fixture, unit-version check and unit/session/region QC define the source loading route; a complete published scoring roster still needs reconciliation.

evidence.locator: TARGET, align_time, time_window, n_runs, estimator_kwargs and trial-mask settings
evidence.supports: Stimulus-side decoding uses nonzero contrast and 0-100 ms stimulus-aligned input; pinned logistic maximum iterations differs from the manuscript.

evidence.locator: run-specific random seeds; shuffled KFold; balanced_accuracy_score/r2_score; concatenated prediction scoring
evidence.supports: Author code supplies deterministic run seeds and nested scoring machinery, but no rerun result is established by this inspection.
Real/null scores are averaged over runs; predictions can be rescored; summary effects retain session and regional identities.

evidence.locator: Full-cohort decoding and summary-table generation workflow
evidence.supports: The source provides a complete-cohort execution route. Debugging subsets are not equivalent to the paper cohort.

Source regional effects subtract separately computed medians; session Fisher p-values, BH q-values and fraction of significant sessions are retained. Minimum source figure eligibility is five units and two sessions.

evidence.locator: Formatted result rows: run_id=i_run+1; R2_test from Rsquared_test_full; balanced_acc_test from balanced_acc_test_full
evidence.supports: Raw run IDs and formatted run IDs differ by one. Original whole-run scores, trial-indexed prediction arrays, targets and fold indices are source-native granular outputs.

evidence.locator: TARGET; TIME_WINDOW; BINSIZE; N_BINS_LAG; N_PSEUDO; N_RUNS; SAVE_PREDICTIONS_PSEUDO
evidence.supports: Wheel speed uses 20-ms bins and ten causal lag bins around first movement, two repeats and 100 null sessions; source settings do not save null predictions.

evidence.locator: TARGET; TIME_WINDOW; BINSIZE; N_BINS_LAG; N_PSEUDO; N_RUNS; SAVE_PREDICTIONS_PSEUDO
evidence.supports: Wheel velocity is a separate original endpoint with the same source timing, repeat and null counts, not a replacement or pooled wheel score.
The complete source table is filtered by source unit/session/region eligibility; neither a small debug cohort nor an arbitrary region subset recovers the original vector.

Accepted operator-only software rescores original-trial-order real predictions, checks full run/null identity support and returns both reducer profiles. It does not authenticate source cohorts, independently rescore null predictions, execute AI analyses, or establish scientific reproduction.

evidence.locator: Representation of the visual stimulus; Fig. 4a,f,i and caption
evidence.supports: The source names VISp among visual-stimulus decoding regions and presents its original decoding result. Fig. 4a/f reports the region-level null-corrected balanced-accuracy quantity; Fig. 4i is a distinct example probability curve.

evidence.locator: Representation of choice; Fig. 5a,f,g,i and caption
evidence.supports: The source identifies GRN among strongest choice decoding regions and states that choice decoding covers more brain regions than visual-stimulus decoding. The original window is the 100 ms preceding first wheel movement.

evidence.locator: Representation of feedback; Fig. 6a,f,i and caption
evidence.supports: The source presents the IRN feedback decoding example and the complete regional feedback map, using the 200 ms after feedback onset. The original region-level quantity is null-corrected balanced accuracy; a selected example is not the entire regional panel.

evidence.locator: Representation of wheel movement; Fig. 7a,c,e,f,g; Supplementary Fig. 7; Methods Decoding target variables
evidence.supports: The paper reports wheel speed decoding in 163 of 201 reportable regions, names GRN among strongest speed effects, and presents GRN speed and velocity decoding examples. Methods specify wheel R-squared; the Fig. 7a caption instead says balanced accuracy, an unresolved wording discrepancy that must not silently change the metric.

target.description: Decode source stimulus side, choice, feedback and wheel variables by brain region; keep endpoint identities separate and preserve the complete registered regional representation scope.

dataset.description: IBL 2023_12_bwm_release with source sorted-spike/trial loaders and unit-version verification.

cohort.description: The paper reports 139 mice, 459 sessions/699 insertions, and 201 analyzed regions/62,857 neurons. The exact endpoint-specific session/unit/region manifest and paper eligibility parity are not frozen here.

split.description: Nested fivefold random interleaved trial CV within each session; ten repetitions for binary targets and two for wheel targets. Retain original fold/seed rules; mouse-held-out evaluation would change the task.

inputs.description: Source-QC neural population spikes per session/region and declared event windows; behavioral targets are labels, not additional decoder features.

preprocessing.description: Source windows and QC are documented, but manuscript logistic max_iter=20000 versus pinned stimulus config max_iter=1000 and downstream region/unit eligibility require reconciliation before baseline replay.

metric.description: Binary balanced accuracy is the mean of class recalls; continuous wheel R-squared is 1-SSE/SST. Use each original target metric and source null correction without replacing them with significance or fraction-responsive scores.

aggregation.description: Score concatenated outer-test predictions per run, average runs per session, then report regional median of session score minus its null median. Significance combines session evidence separately.

full_panel.description: The complete original five-target regional population-decoding family in Figures 4a, 5a, 6a and 7a,c, with source controls needed to interpret full session/regional results. Preserve each target's original metric, cohort, window, masks, within-session validation, real/null comparisons and complete eligible effect vector. This is an explicit named selection now, not a historically frozen panel or an all-paper requirement. Required source-indexed families below retain every original real/null run score, repeated-run mean, both session-null medians, session-corrected effect, both unresolved regional reducer profiles, session p-value, regional Fisher p-value, complete-family BH q-value/call and significant-session fraction. Record keys are original endpoint/session/region/pseudo/run identities rather than an invented rectangular cohort or a cross-target score. The existing original example probability/time-course outputs, original-order real targets/predictions, null derivation evidence, all retained/excluded mouse/probe/unit/trial identities, target-specific masks and outer/inner folds remain mandatory granular companions. Their authentic support/coordinates and independent verification are missing. Eight preserved individually identified scalar/categorical findings are associated source summaries only and cannot replace these complete indexed families and companions. Other single-cell, GLM, trajectory and latency analyses are separately named source evidence rather than automatic primary obligations. Stronger decoding cannot establish unique or causal representation; task-variable correlation and feedback/consumption confounds remain. Original significance is not a superiority criterion, and new cross-mouse evaluation cannot replace source within-session validation.

permitted_observations.description: The original decoder observes source-QC sorted neural population spikes, with probes merged within each session and region, in the original target-specific event windows. Trial events provide alignment and source masks; behavioral stimulus, choice, feedback and wheel values are targets rather than extra predictive features. Preserve original within-session nested trial folds and the causal wheel lag/bin structure. Paper+data and paper+data+author-code must use identical original data, masks, folds, endpoint coverage, target access and budgets; only the pinned author code may be added in the latter condition. Source targets and operator scoring arrays are not silently delivered as candidate features.
